description: Angular component for a dialog used to test and edit calculated field scripts within the Thingsboard platform. It includes UI logic, script testing, resizing, and interaction with backend services.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldTestScriptDialogData
classes.description: Interface extending input parameters for the script test dialog, including editor completer and highlight rules.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldScriptTestDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a dialog for testing and editing calculated field scripts, with UI and backend interaction.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes resize observation after view components are loaded.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer on component destruction.

methods.name: onTestScript
methods.description: Triggers script testing and updates output field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Tests script and closes dialog with the expression if successful.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Performs script testing via backend service, handles errors, and returns output.

methods.name: observeResize
methods.description: Sets up resize observer for layout adjustments.

methods.name: updateSizes
methods.description: Adjusts layout based on container width.

methods.name: getTestArguments
methods.description: Prepares arguments for script testing, including argument types.

methods.name: getArgumentsValue
methods.description: Retrieves and processes argument values from form data.

methods.name: initSplitLayout
methods.description: Initializes split layout for UI panels based on screen size.
